description: Formal Data-Access Registry for High-Resolution / Fine-Scale Observational Networks across India (SIH Problem Statement 26074)
governance_note: No restricted government portals were scraped, penetrated, or bypassed. All institutional access pathways require formal administrative MoUs.

networks.network: Karnataka State Natural Disaster Monitoring Centre (KSNDMC) Telemetric Weather Stations
networks.institution: Karnataka State Natural Disaster Monitoring Centre (KSNDMC), Department of Revenue, Government of Karnataka
networks.spatial_scale: Gram Panchayat Level (~3 to 5 km grid spacing)
networks.expected_coverage: Entire territory of Karnataka (all 31 districts, ~6,000 Gram Panchayats)
networks.agricultural_relevance: CRITICAL / GOLD STANDARD — Purpose-built at Gram Panchayat administrative density for drought monitoring and crop insurance (PMFBY). Sited in rural/agrarian Panchayat office or village school compounds.
networks.authentication_requirement: State Intranet IP Whitelisting / Departmental API Token / Official Institutional MoU
networks.current_accessibility: Public web portal active (HTTP 200); Raw telemetric API endpoints restricted to Karnataka State Data Centre (KSDC) intranet; timed out externally.
networks.formal_access_route: Formal research collaboration agreement / MoU with Director, KSNDMC, Major Sandeep Unnikrishnan Road, Bengaluru.
networks.responsible_institution: Department of Revenue & Disaster Management, Government of Karnataka
networks.validation_value: HIGHEST POSSIBLE — Enables genuine Level 5 and Level 6 Panchayat-density observational validation across Peninsular Deccan agro-ecosystems.

networks.institution: Department of Agriculture, Government of Maharashtra (MahaAgri / Skymet PPP)
networks.spatial_scale: Revenue Circle Level (~8 to 12 km grid spacing)
networks.agricultural_relevance: CRITICAL — Designed specifically for agro-advisories and weather-based crop insurance scheme (WBCIS). Sited in agricultural revenue circles.
networks.authentication_requirement: Departmental API Key / Government of Maharashtra Agriculture Portal Authorization
networks.current_accessibility: mahavedh.maharashtra.gov.in DNS unrouted on public commercial internet; restricted to Maharashtra State Swan (MSWAN).
networks.formal_access_route: Formal data request to Commissionerate of Agriculture, Central Building, Pune, Government of Maharashtra.
networks.responsible_institution: Department of Agriculture, Government of Maharashtra
networks.validation_value: VERY HIGH — Enables validation across Vidarbha dryland, Marathwada rainshadow, and Western Ghats transitional escarpments.

networks.institution: India Meteorological Department (IMD), Ministry of Earth Sciences (MoES), Government of India
networks.spatial_scale: District / Agricultural Research Station Level (~25 to 50 km)
networks.expected_coverage: Key agricultural districts across all 28 States and 8 UTs
networks.agricultural_relevance: HIGH — Sited within ICAR institutes, Krishi Vigyan Kendras, and State Agricultural University campuses; includes sub-surface soil thermometers.
networks.authentication_requirement: MoES Closed Gateway / IMD National Data Centre (NDC) Pune Approval
networks.current_accessibility: aws.imd.gov.in connection timed out; API access closed behind departmental security gateway.
networks.formal_access_route: Formal research data request through IMD National Data Centre (NDC), Shivajinagar, Pune, under MoES Data Policy (NDSAP).
networks.responsible_institution: Agricultural Meteorology Division, India Meteorological Department, Pune
networks.validation_value: HIGH — Provides high-accuracy WMO-standard physical ground truth across all major agro-climatic zones of India.

networks.network: District Agricultural Meteorology Units (DAMU) at Krishi Vigyan Kendras
networks.institution: Joint IMD / ICAR National Krishi Vigyan Kendra Network
networks.spatial_scale: Sub-District / KVK Experimental Farm Level (~30 to 60 km)
networks.expected_temporal_resolution: Twice Daily (08:30 & 17:30 IST) / Hourly AWS where automated
networks.expected_coverage: 530 rural KVKs in priority agricultural districts
networks.agricultural_relevance: HIGH — Directly aligned with the Gramin Krishi Mausam Sewa (GKMS) bulletin dissemination units; situated in active crop research plots.
networks.current_accessibility: Integrated into bi-weekly agromet advisory text bulletins; raw automated time-series API not publicly exposed.
networks.formal_access_route: Joint MoES-ICAR Agromet Coordination Committee application.
networks.responsible_institution: Division of Agricultural Physics (ICAR) & IMD Agromet Advisory Service
networks.validation_value: HIGH — Direct ground calibration for farmer-facing agromet risk thresholds.

networks.network: ICAR Krishi Vigyan Kendra National Portal Observatories
networks.institution: Indian Council of Agricultural Research (ICAR), Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare
networks.spatial_scale: KVK Farm Point Stations (~40 to 80 km)
networks.agricultural_relevance: VERY HIGH for crop stage; MODERATE for hourly diurnal downscaling.
networks.authentication_requirement: ICAR ERP / KVK Portal Admin Authentication
networks.current_accessibility: kvk.icar.gov.in DNS unrouted; no REST API available.
networks.formal_access_route: Deputy Director General (Agricultural Extension), ICAR, Krishi Anusandhan Bhawan, New Delhi.
networks.validation_value: MODERATE — Essential for crop phenological alignment, but lacks sub-hourly diurnal resolution.

networks.institution: All India Coordinated Research Project on Agrometeorology (AICRPAM / 25 State Agricultural Universities)
networks.agricultural_relevance: HIGH for microclimatic physics and soil thermal inertia; LOW for rapid automated spatial downscaling verification.
networks.authentication_requirement: Offline Academic Data Request / Institutional Physical Records
networks.current_accessibility: Archived in printed annual reports and local university ledger books; no centralized network API.
networks.formal_access_route: AICRPAM Coordinating Unit, ICAR-CRIDA, Santoshnagar, Hyderabad.
networks.responsible_institution: Central Research Institute for Dryland Agriculture (CRIDA), ICAR
networks.validation_value: MODERATE — Benchmarks microclimatic soil temperature physics.

networks.network: ISRO MOSDAC In-Situ Automatic Weather Station Network
networks.institution: Space Applications Centre (SAC), Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO)
networks.expected_coverage: Pan-India, including island territories and high-altitude Himalayan stations
networks.agricultural_relevance: MODERATE to HIGH — Dense siting in remote and agricultural zones complementing IMD.
networks.authentication_requirement: ISRO MOSDAC User SSO Registration & Security Clearance
networks.current_accessibility: Web portal reachable (HTTP 200); batch automated programmatic downloads require approved credentials.
networks.formal_access_route: Online registration at www.mosdac.gov.in followed by formal research justification submitted to SAC Ahmedabad.
networks.validation_value: HIGH — Independent physical ground truth outside IMD network.

networks.agricultural_relevance: ESSENTIAL COVARIATE — Provides topographic and surface feature inputs for Dynamic Residual V2 model.
networks.current_accessibility: Web portal and WMS tile services reachable (HTTP 200).
networks.validation_value: SUPPORTING_ONLY — Provides geographic covariates, not physical validation ground truth.

networks.network: Central Pollution Control Board Continuous Ambient Air Quality Monitoring Stations
networks.institution: Central Pollution Control Board (CPCB), Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change
networks.spatial_scale: Urban Micro-Scale (~2 to 5 km within Tier-1/2 cities)
variables: Air Quality Parameters (PM2.5, PM10, NOx, SO2, CO)
networks.expected_coverage: Major metropolitan cities and industrial corridors (Delhi, Mumbai, Bengaluru, Lucknow, etc.)
networks.agricultural_relevance: VERY LOW — Sited in heavy urban intersections, commercial centers, and industrial parks; subject to intense urban heat island (UHI) contamination.
networks.authentication_requirement: Public Portal Web Scraping / Central Control Room CCR API
networks.responsible_institution: Air Quality Division, CPCB, New Delhi
networks.validation_value: LOW FOR AGRO-WEATHER — Provides dense urban spatial pairs, but cannot be treated as representative of rural agricultural microclimates.

networks.network: NOAA Integrated Surface Database (ISD) / WMO GTS Synoptic Network
networks.institution: World Meteorological Organization (WMO) / NOAA NCEI / IMD
networks.expected_coverage: 21 States and Union Territories across India
networks.agricultural_relevance: MODERATE — Gold-standard calibrated physical thermometers, but primarily sited at civil aerodromes and regional IMD offices.
networks.current_accessibility: 100% CONNECTED & VERIFIED — Ingested 313,754 observations across 42 national stations over 18 multi-season months (Tasks 1B & 2).
networks.formal_access_route: NOAA NCEI ISD Lite Public Data Access (https://www.ncei.noaa.gov/pub/data/noaa/isd-lite/).
networks.responsible_institution: National Centers for Environmental Information (NOAA) & WMO
networks.validation_value: FOUNDATIONAL BASELINE — Proves national macro-scale calibration, but structurally incapable of sub-5 km Panchayat validation.
